dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - August 08, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Rays Fly Past Mariners, Dodgers Edge D-backs in Thrilling Finale**

A thrilling day in the world of Major League Baseball saw several teams emerge victorious in closely contested matches. Josh Naylor's impressive performance for the Tampa Bay Rays was a highlight, as he hit two home runs and drove in two runs to lead his team to a 3-2 win over the Seattle Mariners. Naylor's efforts were instrumental in securing the victory, and he finished the day with a batting line of 3 H, 2 HR, 2 RBI, 4 AB.

In another exciting matchup, the Los Angeles Dodgers edged the Arizona Diamondbacks 2-1 behind the strong pitching of Yoshinobu Yamamoto, who threw 5.2 scoreless innings with six strikeouts. Kyle Tucker also made an impact for the Dodgers, hitting a solo home run to drive in the game-winning run.

Gerrit Cole and Gage Jump impressed in their respective starts, leading their teams to victories. Cole pitched 7.0 strong innings for the New York Yankees, striking out nine and allowing just two earned runs. Jump, meanwhile, tossed 6.0 innings for the Athletics, fanning 11 and surrendering only two earned runs.

The day's biggest home run hitters were Jac Caglianone, who hit two home runs for the Chicago Cubs, and Josh Naylor, who also hit two for the Tampa Bay Rays.
